text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm out with Agnes Digital shopping for Umamusume merch, when…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Look at that super long line. What do you think they're selling?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're not necessarily selling anything, but we go take a look and find…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Hey! You, with the big bow! Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Do you get some kinda Uma merch if you get the very last ball? If so, I'll pull them all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stop Agnes Digital before she throws all her cash at the clerk and convince her to just try once.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… is this one of those scenes where I get just one chance, but still get super happy no matter what I get? Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Despite the slim chances of winning some Uma merch, I'll give it a spin and pray for something close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Show me the Umas!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that slightly off-kilter plea, we both take hold of the raffle machine's lever and give it a spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwoooaaa?! We got a holy macker—I mean, grand prize?! Talk about hitting the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We're going on a vacation… Gasp! Do you know what that means?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's a private offline meet-up! We get to spend two whole days together talking about Umamusume in person!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We can go over everyone we've seen over our three years together! From the rookie Umas fresh off their debut to the refined and mature seniors!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We can stay up all night talking about all our Twinkle Series memories! After we've finished our twelve-season run, that is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she really meant it when she said "all" of our Twinkle Series memories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That means we've gotta prepare tons and tons of good memories if we want this to be the best trip ever.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So, can you hold onto that ticket until we're ready, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In the meantime, I'll become a living photo album capturing everyone's precious moments!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All fired up to collect more mementos for our future trip, Agnes Digital starts the year off with more heat than a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohh… We got the B prize—I mean the first prize! Quick, hit record! I wanna remember this moment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A deluxe carrot hamburger steak… Nice! I want something special to go with it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, you. If you wanna make something extra delicious, you need to top it off with a bit of fantasizing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Picture a soft, hearty hamburger steak surrounded by a throng of peaceful, precious Umas…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I could eat three whole bowls of rice thinking about it! Just imagine what I could do with this hamburger steak with a fantasy like that as a side!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right! I need to get home right away and get started on this fantasy dinner! You're coming too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, Agnes Digital and I enjoy our prize hamburger steak while she fantasizes about a round-table feast full of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wow, a whole bushel. It looks like they cleared out the whole storehouse.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Anyways… Hehehe… The more you look at 'em… Don't you think these carrots start to look like Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: For instance… Here, look at this one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It looks slim and tough, but it's probably tender on the inside… Just like Taishin…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And then the smaller one next to it reminds me of Akebono's collarbone. And the one with all the leaves is like Fuji wearing a big stage wig… ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh! And if you view this one from a certain angle—yeah, that's so her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her unique skill is being able to see Umamusume in anything. She carefully observes each carrot before savoring its flavor.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: One carrot… Well, I was only given one chance, so I guess that tracks.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nah. I'm well aware of how tough it is to arrange a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Thinking up the lineup of prizes, procuring the items, and then arranging them in a display… It's certainly no cakewalk.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Anyone who thinks they're gonna take home the one prize that rules them all with just one shot is a nutcase.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: At the end of the day, simping is about support, and that's my default state of mind. Yessir…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back to campus, Agnes Digital appears enlightened as she enjoys her singular carrot.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Tissues, huh? …Oh! Maybe they have an Umamusume design!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, doesn't look like it. They're just plain, ordinary tissues…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But I guess this beats getting random tissues from someone promoting something on the street…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I hate getting handouts from strangers. Whenever they try, I always just run away. Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All that said, a loss is a loss at the end of the day. Agnes Digital winds up feeling a little down.
